limitations.text: A collective kernel's time is transfer plus waiting for the slowest rank. Tracing changes which rank arrives last, so per-rank collective time and rank skew in a traced run do not describe the untraced server. Use the minimum across ranks per launch (the transfer estimate) for collective cost; do not rank optimization sites by collective wait.
Tracing adds host time per traced dispatch. Compare kernel time within a run, not a traced run's latency or throughput with an untraced baseline.
Without the CPU op tree, ops are modules (class or path) and the shape is the first input's; FLOP and roofline models keyed on aten ops do not apply.
